labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Reporter asks 'Am I doing it wrong?'; documented column options (no_wrap, min_width) apply, so this is a usage question.

body:
The column options are described in [tables.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst). `no_wrap` stops a column from wrapping, and `min_width` sets the smallest width a column can shrink to. With `no_wrap=True`, the other columns can be squeezed, which is similar to the report in #2890, so it may be a related issue rather than a usage error. For help choosing column widths for your table, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
